---
title: "Research"
subtitle: "What I work on, and what has come out of it"
---

Open with a short framing paragraph: the overarching question that connects your
work, stated in language a colleague from a neighbouring field would follow.
Say what puzzle you are chasing, the methods you bring to it, and why the answer
matters beyond your subfield. Three or four sentences is plenty — this is the
paragraph a search committee actually reads.

An up-to-date list is also on
[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=YOUR-SCHOLAR-ID) and
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/YOUR-ORCID-ID). † denotes equal contribution.
